title: Derangement permutation matrices and orbit harmonics
summary: Let $\mathbf{x}_{n \times n}$ be an $n \times n$ matrix of variables and let $S = \mathbb{F}[\mathbf{x}_{n \times n}]$ be the polynomial ring over these variables where $\mathbb{F}$ is a field of characteristic zero. Regard $S$ as the coordinate ring of the affine space $\mathbb{F}^{n \times n}$ of $n \times n$ $\mathbb{F}$-matrices. Let $\mathfrak{D}_n \subseteq \mathbb{F}^{n \times n}$ be the locus of derangement permutation matrices.
